Four schematic stellar-population regions retain the descending main-sequence band, upper-right giants, upper supergiants and lower-left white dwarfs. The main-sequence band is independently widened to 10 mm and the supergiant band to 12 mm. Five temperature and six luminosity stations retain logarithmic coordinates: temperature decreases rightward from 30000 to 2500 K; luminosity rises from 0.0001 to 1000000 solar units. Ticks are attached 13 mm axis branches. Region outlines are broad teaching guides, not precise boundaries, individual stars, evolutionary tracks or inferred ages.
